title: The Judges of the Land of Israel
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: They are Rabbi Ami and Rabbi Assi, as in Sanhedrin 17b. In Bava Batra 70b they said: “Shall we say it is the dispute of these Tannaim, as it was taught: The judges of the Diaspora say he swears; the judges of the Land of Israel say,” etc. Hyman calls the words “of these Tannaim, as it was taught” a printing error, and Tosafot on Ketubot 92b, s.v. Dinah, copied it correctly.
